note: MODEL GATE for the agentic arm (TODO Stage 4 item 6). Runs on data/agent_devset.json, which is NEVER scored in the thesis. Read COMPLIANCE AND COST ONLY: malformed-action rate, budget exhaustion, no-answer rate, turns, tool calls, probe restarts, thought uptake, wall clock per case. Dev entries have no floors (they are not in testset_discriminability.json), so skill is undefined and NO dev-set F1 may be quoted anywhere. Select the model with --model-idx and the thought condition with --agent-thought.
prompt_strategies_note: The gate measures the tool rung A1 only.
constrained_bounded_note: No free whitespace and tree lists bounded at twice the largest gold list (LLM.OCPQ_TREE_MAX_ITEMS), notes 43.8: base Llama wrote ~3900 tokens of blanks in one turn and repeated list items in others. Every gold tree still passes (tests/test_constrained_decoding.py). All rungs, A0 included.
decoding_note: Constrained decoding and the 4000-token budget are B0's (notes 41); A0 is B0's one-shot prompt on the arm's own BASE model (notes 43.6). The grammar is ORDERED (constrained_any_order false, notes 43.7): xgrammar's any_order admits a repeated key, and base Llama looped on one in 58 of 70 smoke turns. It applies to every rung, A0 included, so the rungs share one grammar; the ordered grammar still admits every gold tree written in schema order. For the loop rungs the grammar is the AgentTurn union per turn (notes 43.5).
agent_protocol_note: Stage 5 levers (notes 43.12), letters FBEXL in the directory suffix: F structure report on try_query + a static check_tree tool in BOTH loop rungs (A1 - A1' isolates log access); B a final tree with blocking defects is returned once; E fall back to the last tree the probe EVALUATED first (amends the pre-registered rule); X tree-linking rules + one worked example (invented domain; A0 keeps B0's prompt, so A1 - A0 includes it); L the last turn admits a final answer only. All false reproduces the model gate of notes 43.11. The prompt hash is recorded in the manifest (agentic.prompt_sha256).
agent_turn_token_budget_note: Per-TURN cap for the loop rungs (A1, A1-prime, A2, A1+thought); A0 keeps generation_token_budget. Bounds what a runaway turn costs (~48 s instead of ~95 s), not an answer: tests/test_agent_turn_budget.py checks every gold tree fits with margin in each evaluated model's own tokens. Notes 43.8.
agent_budget_note: Defaults = A1. A2's budget is passed by flag and must be SIZED FROM THE MODEL GATE's measured per-case wall clock so it fits case_timeout_sec (600), which CLAUDE.md 6 requires to be the same on every compared arm. See TODO, Stage 4 item 7.
models_note: Index order is load-bearing: the submit scripts select by the EXPANDED index (even = base, odd = its adapter). Muse Glimmer (notes 43.16) is appended LAST so every earlier index is unchanged; it has no adapter (finetuned: false), so it is index 8 and nothing follows it. Its revision pins the hub commit; chat_template_kwargs and generation_prefix are its chat settings, frozen after its model gate.
agent_repeat_guard_note: R (notes 43.17), letter R after L (C stays off): an action identical to an earlier one of the same case -- same tool, same arguments, the thought ignored -- is not re-run; the model is told which turn made it and that nothing new would come back. It adds no prompt text, so the three frozen prompt hashes are unchanged. Added after Muse Glimmer's gate (57% of its turns repeated an earlier action) and run on BOTH models, so the two arms share one protocol, pFBEXLR. The completed Ministral pFBEXL run (notes 43.15, eval_runs/agentic) is not replaced; this config writes to eval_runs/agentic_r so the two protocols never share a directory.
preload_model_note: Load the model before the case loop, outside case_timeout_sec (notes 43.17). Lazily it loads inside the first case's cap, which a 60 GB checkpoint (Muse Glimmer) can exhaust. Changes no output, only where the load time is counted.
